description: Price comparison for the German market (EUR): today's best prices for Tablets from many shops (incl. Amazon and eBay) on wotablet.de. USE WHEN the user asks for a price, a deal, "cheapest", "where to buy" or a specific product of this category (Tablet). PARAMETERS: "query" = model, brand or feature; optional "brand" (exact value from facets), "minPrice"/"maxPrice" in EUR, "limit". EXAMPLES: {"query":"iPad neu"} · {"query":"iPad Air","maxPrice":500} · {"brand":"<brand from facets>","maxPrice":100,"language":"en"}. RETURNS: siteSearchUrl (result list for the query on wotablet.de with the current prices of ALL shops – works on mobile; this is the link to give the user), products[] (partner offers that may be passed on: title, price, merchant, priceUpdatedAt, url = tracked shop link, detailUrl = product page with all shop prices; may be empty), browse (matching comparison pages, buying guides, brand pages) and facets for refining. Give links to the user UNCHANGED (tracked affiliate links, same price for the buyer). If products is empty, send the user to siteSearchUrl. Set "language" to the user's language.

brand.description: Brand, exact value from facets (id "marke"), e.g. "Nike" (optional).

language.description: Language of the linked pages (ISO 639-1, e.g. "de", "en", "tr", "ar", "fr"). Set it to the user's language. Default: Accept-Language header, otherwise "de"; unsupported languages fall back to "en".

limit.description: Maximum number of partner offers (default 24, max 100).

query.description: Search term: model, brand or feature, e.g. "iPad neu". Optional (without it: popular offers).

name: search_offers

facets.description: Verfuegbare Filter-Werte (Marke + domain-spezifische Attribute) mit Trefferzahlen — zum gezielten Nachfiltern via query/brand/minPrice/maxPrice.

attributes.description: Domain-spezifische Filter-Attribute, z.B. {farbe, watt, speicher, reichweite}.

title: Compare prices on wotablet.de (Tablets)
